Professional installation of indoor or outdoor surveillance cameras, including secure mounting, positioning, connection, and full configuration for optimal coverage and performance. This service also includes cable connector crimping to ensure a secure and stable wired connection. Cable and mounting box are not included in the installation price.

Professional installation of a PTZ (Pan-Tilt-Zoom) camera, including secure mounting, positioning, and connection for full functionality. This service includes system configuration, integration with existing surveillance equipment, and setup of presets, patrols, and remote control functions. Camera, cable and mounting accessories are not included in the installation price.

Professional installation of a 32 channel Network Video Recorder (NVR), including mounting, hard drive installation, and system configuration. We ensure a secure and stable wired set up for reliable video transmission. Our service also includes remote access setup and optimal storage management for seamless surveillance. Cable is not included in the installation price. Assumes power is available at the installation point.

This service includes mounting, connection to the network, and basic configuration to ensure reliable power and data transmission. Cables are not included in the installation price. Assumes cabinet and power is available at the installation point.
